foreign key — its arrow points to the entity it references
polymorphic reference — the entity column and the id column
computed by a rule: computed, calculation, Server SQL or auto-key
read-only: [READONLY], or written by code the model does not declare (transition, import, route)
polymorphic reference — one arrow per permitted target, no foreign key
drawn short: the target is a hub, or the reference is read-only
